text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond concluded her first three years
in the Twinkle Series with splendid results.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond! Have you decided on your next race yet? All sorts of rumors are flying around!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
In the same race as Kitasan Black-san!?
Or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: To the world beyond—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I will take on a race steeped in tradition and prestige, carving out a new era of history for Japanese Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Which means... to France!?
Details, please! Tell me everything!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond's declaration to take on overseas challenges sent waves of excitement throughout Japan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her dignified demeanor, devoid of any doubt of victory,
surely made many people feel the possibility of a new era in history—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Encouragement! I expect great things from you!
I'll be waiting for good news!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! As a representative of Japan's Umamusume,
I shall run with majestic dignity.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
“And I shall without fail fulfill the long-cherished dream
of Japanese Umamusume!”

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Travel arrangements have been completed.
Details have been sent via email,
so please both check them carefully.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Please take care, and have a safe trip.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: We're finally heading out, Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? What a complicated expression.
Are you not pleased?
choice_data_list: I thought that was pretty fast...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond's expedition to France was decided soon after completing her first three years in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as procedures for the overseas expedition progressed,
the departure day arrived in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I have decided to keep taking on challenges.
If so, I have no time to stand still."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I shall challenge every pinnacle and forge a new history for the Satono family and the Japanese Umamusume world!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Besides, the harder the goal is, the more rewarding it is to achieve, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond speaks with burning passion.
Once one dream comes true, on to the next.
Her fire will never burn out.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are! Dia-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"You're leaving tomorrow, right?
We won't see each other for a while, so I wanted to say goodbye!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Don't forget the souvenirs, okay!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, understood♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san, that's not right at all!
Satono-san, why are you nodding along, too?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's not like we're saying goodbye forever.
If anything, I'm really looking forward
to running with Dia-chan once she's back!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: T-That goes for me too...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm honored.
I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. I shall be awaiting your arrival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
May the history of the Satono family you weave from here on
be filled with great glory.
As a member of the Mejiro family, I look forward to watching it unfold.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Have a wonderful trip, Satono-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm off!
McQueen-san, Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the next day. The day of departure—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Father, Mother~~~!
Sorry to have kept you waiting~~~!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're finally here...!
Thank goodness... You're late, you know. I was worried!
choice_data_list: I am so terribly sorry for keeping you waiting...!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: Did something go wrong?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I ended up running late
because I was packing my suitcase.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Mother
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? You packed this morning?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahaha~... Actually, you see...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan, isn't it about time?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Kita-chan... I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait, Dia-chan, where's your luggage?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I gave it to Tazuna-san yesterday.
She said she'd have it sent to the hotel.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's not it! I mean the stuff we're taking today!
Like a change of clothes for now, toiletries, and all that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I told you, I already sent them to the hotel.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Wait!?
It won't reach France in a single day, you know!?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fue? Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
“Still, when I traveled abroad with my family,
it was already there by the time we arrived at the hotel, you know?”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I bet Dia-chan just didn't know about it,
and the old folks either carried it in their luggage
or shipped it way in advance!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Agh, there's no time to waste!!
Dia-chan! Start packing!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A-All right...!
Where did I put that large suitcase...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I should contact Trainer
and have them check in first!
And ask them to hold baggage drop-off for me...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...And so, since I was worried about Dia-chan being all on her own,
I ended up coming along to see her off too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks to Kita-chan and Trainer,
I made it in time!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, I'm always sorry for troubling you...
Thank you so, so much.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't mind at all!
After all, I'm the Helping Champion!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“Starting now, though...
...Wait, now I'm getting
super worried about it...!”

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're such a worrywart, Kita-chan.
I can handle things on my own now, really!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!!
Please make sure to watch over Dia-chan, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
...I am so sorry for causing trouble...
My daughter is rather naive to the ways of the world...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, not you too, Father...!
I told you I'm perfectly fine...

text_block_list.name: Dia's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...The reason Dia can feel so at ease must be because she has a Trainer she trusts so deeply.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's true.
You're the Trainer who guided me all the way here, after all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I have no fears about the road ahead, either!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please continue to guide Dia—the crown jewel of the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
Dia, we support the challenge you've chosen for yourself.
Go and give it your all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Father, Mother.
Dia shall carve her name into history
as a 'renowned Umamusume' of the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Please look forward to it, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Satono Diamond took flight.
To forge a path toward a new history.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The path she walks from here on out
will surely shine brilliantly in history.
Just like a diamond—"
